scope: orthogonal same-cell molecular-age coupling development gate; not a perturbation-by-challenge or biological-replication claim

observables.old_rna: whole transcriptome counts minus nascent transcriptome counts in the same cell
observables.new_rna: nascent transcriptome counts in the same cell
observables.perturbation: target_genes with guide identity in target

eligibility.target_rule: exactly three observed guide labels and at least 60 retained cells for every guide
eligibility.failure_reporting: report every library target failing observed-cell, three-guide, or minimum-cell criteria

feature_freeze.normalization: within-layer counts per 10000 followed by log1p
feature_freeze.negative_old_count_rule: refuse if whole minus nascent contains any negative entry
feature_freeze.genes: top 1000 non-mitochondrial shared genes by geometric mean of old- and new-layer variance ranks on NO-TARGET cells
feature_freeze.state_partition: separate three-cluster k-means partitions of old and new NO-TARGET PCA coordinates, n_init=50

guide_disjoint_validation.outer_folds: three rotations of lexicographically sorted target guides; one guide held out per target
guide_disjoint_validation.control_folds: lexicographically sorted NO-TARGET guides partitioned by index modulo three; five held out and ten fitted per fold
guide_disjoint_validation.inner_selection: swap the two fitted target guides and minimize mean held-guide standardized field MSE; recipient outer guide is never used for selection

methods: joint nuclear-norm P-by-old-state-by-new-state coupling atlas with every lower-order term
saturated pooled hierarchical PUV fit with zero nuclear penalty
endpoint old/new marginal summary with independence coupling
linear old-by-new cross-covariance contrast with inner-fold scalar calibration
nuclear atlas after same-guide pair destruction

field: pooled Pearson correlation across target-by-route coefficients
target_neighborhood: mean top-five neighbor overlap with held-guide atlas
Spearman correlation of target-pair cosine similarities
pathway_and_module: average precision for target pairs sharing an eligible Reactome pathway
average precision for target pairs sharing an eligible CORUM complex
primary_metrics.refusal: refuse promotion if the selected nuclear fit does not reduce PUV parameter dimension or is more than 10% worse than saturated pooled standardized MSE in at least two outer folds

annotation_rules.reactome: retain pathways containing 3 to 25 eligible targets
annotation_rules.corum: retain complexes containing 2 to 20 eligible targets
annotation_rules.pair_positive: two distinct targets share at least one retained annotation

known_metadata_attrition_before_expressi.EP300: present in the PerturbSci-Kinetics library but absent from the deposited on-target cell metadata
